body:
# OnyxLib

OnyxLib is a framework for creating custom content using PaperMC.

OnyxLib streamlines custom item creation so end-devs can focus on creating cool stuff. OnyxLib is not a full abstraction layer, composition and direct-access to native API's is always preferred over restrictive framework "features".

The crowning feature of OnyxLib is the resource pack generation system. All OnyxLib plugin assets can be combined into a single resourcepack to be put on the server.
